what_it_is: A bimonthly men's magazine about classic tailoring, watches, motoring, travel and what it calls gentlemanly living, built around celebrity cover interviews, fashion shoots, brand histories and essays on craftsmanship and luxury trade. The print edition sits alongside a large online shop selling tailoring and accessories from the brands it writes about, with print and digital editions sold singly or by subscription. It is for readers with an interest in traditional menswear and high-end lifestyle coverage.
